title: Medical Leave Request Letter
description: A letter requesting medical leave from work or school.
intro: Medical Leave Request Letter provides a simple format for healthcare or administrative communication.
whenToUse: Use this template when communicating medical needs or administrative updates.
template:
[Title]

To: [Recipient]

[Statement of need or request].

[Details].

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
Medical Leave Request Letter

To: HR Department

I am requesting medical leave from June 1 to June 15 due to a scheduled procedure. I will provide documentation from my doctor.

Sincerely,
Dana

faqs.question: Do medical leave letters need documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes, attach or mention any required medical documentation if requested.
